lines.trans: So, Mr Lukas, are you really staying in the courtyard at noon to greet Moritz?
Yes, Miriam. Even if he turns around and walks straight back out the gate.
Moritz will not walk out. He always acted tough for five seconds and then softened.
Do you really still remember that after all these years?
